name: SEM
recent: SEM 近期的主要动态集中在股权变动：大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun 在 9 月至 10 月间多次申报买卖公司股份，其中 10 月 5 日出现一笔 2,160 万股的直接持股收购及合计约 1,010 万股间接持股的出售。公司也于 10 月 30 日公布首席人员变动，并于 11 月 20 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告。
notable: 大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun 于 2026 年 10 月 5 日收购 21,600,000 股直接持股，并出售合计 10,107,100 股间接持股。
公司于 2026 年 10 月 30 日公布首席人员变动，Miss Thong Mei Mei 卸任。
公司于 2026 年 11 月 20 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩报告。
risks: 大股东 Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun 在 9 月至 10 月间多次申报股份买卖，包括 10 月 5 日的直接持股收购与间接持股出售。
大股东于 2026 年 10 月 19 日申报在闭市期内有买卖公司证券的意向。

recent_en: SEM's recent developments centred on shareholding changes: major shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun filed multiple notices of dealings in the company's shares between September and October, including a 21.6 million share acquisition of direct interest and disposals of about 10.1 million shares of deemed interest on 5 October. The company also announced a change in principal officer on 30 October and released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November.
notable_en: Major shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun acquired 21,600,000 shares of direct interest and disposed of a total of 10,107,100 shares of deemed interest on 5 October 2026.
The company released its quarterly consolidated results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 20 November 2026.
risks_en: Major shareholder Tan Sri Dato' Seri Vincent Tan Chee Yioun filed multiple notices of share dealings between September and October, including a direct interest acquisition and deemed interest disposals on 5 October.
The major shareholder notified on 19 October 2026 of an intention to deal in the company's securities during the closed period.
